notes.title: WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale
notes.content:
[h3]We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day![/h3]

The [b]WDC World Ocean Day Sale[/b] starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save a fin-tastic [b]up to 75% off KAO games[/b]. We will also donate [b]10%[/b] of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35158179/e38cddd5275d93344bf208c7b6f8826b10dc9878.png[/img]

[b]Who are WDC?[/b]

WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear, pollution, captivity and hunting and whaling. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.

Their mission is to reverse the global decline of whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic beings. And their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.

notes.title: Kao the Kangaroo: Round 2 - Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hi Kao-fans, 
we present you with a hotfix to our latest patch. 

We know that there were some errors with the saves of your progress. 
Current hotfix helps with this problem and you're now able to load properly your old saves.

In case if you saved your progress after 1.1 patch and want to enter this newest playthrough here what you have to do:

[*] Enter %localappdata% directory. Note that this location is hidden. You can enter it by pressing Win button + R. Then type %localappdata% into the search bar
[*] Find Kao2.sg file and copy it
[*] Enter your Steam directory  Steam/userdata/youruserID/1048540/remote 
[*] Make sure to copy your previous saves before you'll overwrite them with the new one
[*] Paste Kao2.sg file


Sorry for the inconvenience - we hope that you can now enjoy our newest patch!

Tate Multimedia

notes.title: Kao the Kangaroo: Round 2 - Patch 1.1: US English Voiceovers, Steam Cards
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35158179/c557dd2af79ae395833290fb3d15483e21cc035e.png[/img]

Good morning Kao-fans!

First of all - the most important thing for us is the knowledge that you're supporting Kao the Kangaroo. We wouldn't be here without your devotion. That's why we wanted to thank you for your engagement and huge feedback that you shared with us. 

[h1]
We're presenting you the first patch for Kao the Kangaroo: Round 2. [/h1]
We needed to address the most important issues based on the feedback that you provided us with. 

List of changes:
[b]
[*] Added original US English voiceovers
[*] Added language selection to the launcher
[*] Fixed DPI scaling - screen no longer crops when the DPI is high on certain devices
[*] Corrected controller dead zones for better diagonal movement
[*] Steam Cards added
[/b]

Hope that you'll find those useful. Please share your feedback with us. Leave us a comment here or on our social media channels. 

Thanks, 
Tate Multimedia
